agent.config: Claude Desktop、Cursor 及其他客户端
agent.intro: An agent connected here (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and others) drives VideoSOS like you do: it picks models and estimates prices, generates images, video, music and voices with your keys, edits the open project's timeline with undo, imports media and exports the video, while you watch every step in this window. Your provider keys are never shown to it.

network.proxyIntro: Everything VideoSOS fetches from the internet goes through it: the generations at OpenRouter, fal and Runware, their model lists, the news and updates. This computer and the local network never do.
network.proxyKindHint: For an address written without one. SOCKS5 resolves site names on the proxy.
network.proxyAddressHint: Any usual form: host:port, host:port:login:password, login:password@host:port, socks5://login:password@host:port.
network.proxyWindowNote: The window itself (model pictures, news) takes the proxy at the next start, and without a login: a browser cannot pass one to SOCKS.
network.accessHint: Opens VideoSOS in a browser on another computer or phone. Everything runs here; the browser needs the access key. Agents on this computer and the window itself need no key.
network.accessRestart: Close and open VideoSOS for this to take effect: the address is set when it starts.
network.accessInternet: From the internet: forward this port to this computer on your router and open http://<your address>:<port>/?key=<key>. Anyone with the key controls VideoSOS and spends on your keys.
